home.badge: Official Site | North Bali Private Pool Villa Estate
home.heroCopy: Eight modern 2-bedroom private pool villas set among emerald rice fields — a serene luxury escape in Temukus, the heart of Lovina, North Bali. Perfect for couples, group getaways, and families looking for a peaceful holiday away from south Bali crowds.
home.villaHeadline: Eight private sanctuaries in the heart of Lovina
home.villaCopy: From our spacious 200 m² Suite residences to the warm timber elegance of Villa Kayu and five thoughtfully appointed Deluxe villas, each two-storey home offers two bedrooms, a ground-floor bathroom, and a private pool — all set within emerald rice fields in Temukus, North Bali.

home.collectionCopy: Each villa has its own character, gallery, and story. Select a residence below to explore photos, layout details, and amenities.
home.why1Body: Wake to views of lush green paddies and the gentle rhythm of rural Bali — far from the crowds of the south.
home.why2Body: Every villa includes its own private plunge pool, creating an intimate sanctuary for couples, families, and friends.
home.why3Body: Dolphin tours at sunrise, hidden waterfalls, snorkeling reefs, and ancient temples — all within easy reach.
home.why4Body: Our attentive team ensures every detail of your stay is handled with care, from arrival to farewell.
home.amenitiesCopy: Thoughtfully included in every villa to make your North Bali escape effortless and relaxing.
home.amenity_pool_body: Your own plunge pool with sun loungers — perfect for cooling off after exploring North Bali.
home.amenity_wifi_body: High-speed wireless internet in every villa for staying connected at your own pace.
home.amenity_kitchen_body: Refrigerator, stove, knife, frying pan, pot, cups, plates, spoon and fork — plus dining utensils for every stay.
home.amenity_ac_body: Climate control in every bedroom for restful sleep in the tropical warmth.
home.amenity_breakfast_body: Fresh towels, room tidying, and pool maintenance so you can simply relax.
home.amenity_concierge_body: Tour arrangements, transport, and local recommendations from our friendly villa team.

home.faq1a: Bhumi Lovina Residence & Villa has eight private villa units, each with two bedrooms, a private pool, and full kitchen facilities.
home.faq2q: What is the check-in and check-out time?
home.faq2a: Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is until 11:00. Early check-in and late check-out may be available on request, subject to availability.
home.faq3q: How far is the villa from the airport?
home.faq3a: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) is approximately 3 hours by car. We can arrange private airport transfers for all bookings.
home.faq4a: Yes. Our team can arrange ethical sunrise dolphin watching tours on traditional Balinese boats, just minutes from the estate.
home.faq5a: Breakfast is not included as standard, but each villa has a full kitchen for self-catering. Nearby cafes and restaurants are also within easy reach.
home.faq6a: Rescheduling must be requested at least 7 days before arrival. All reservations are non-refundable once confirmed.
home.faq7q: What is the best private pool villa for families in Lovina, North Bali?
home.faq7a: Bhumi Lovina offers 8 premium 2-bedroom private pool villas (Suite, Executive Suite, and Deluxe tiers) specifically configured for family vacations, accommodating up to 5 adults or 4 adults and 2 children.
home.faq8q: Does Bhumi Lovina provide full kitchen facilities?
home.faq8a: Yes, every villa features a private kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, stovetop, pans, cookware, plates, and cutlery for your complete convenience.
home.faq9q: Can the villa arrange dolphin watching tours or airport transfers?
home.faq9a: Yes, our on-site villa concierge team directly arranges ethical sunrise dolphin watching tours in Lovina, local waterfall excursions, and private airport transfers from Ngurah Rai (DPS).
home.policyAboutBody:
Total 8 private villa units (2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom on the ground floor).

Maximum capacity is 5 adults, or 4 adults and 2 children (except Villa Kayu Executive — strictly 5 guests maximum).

Important: We do not provide extra beds.

Extra adult: IDR 110,000 per person
Extra child: IDR 55,000 per person

Standard bathroom amenities: soap, shampoo, and 2 towels in every villa.

Check-in: 14:00 | Check-out: 11:00 maximum
home.policyRulesBody:
Late check-out is charged at IDR 55,000 per hour.

Damage caused by guests will be charged according to the extent of damage.

Bhumi Lovina Residence & Villas is not responsible for lost items.

Villa type upgrades require confirmation from our reservations team.

Please keep music at a considerate volume for other guests.
home.policyTermsBody:
Rescheduling must be informed at least 7 days before arrival.

If a booking is cancelled, payment is non-refundable.

home.contactCopy: Whether you have questions about availability, tours, or special requests — our team is here to help make your Bali getaway unforgettable.
